description.describe_ch: 本課程主要的目的在於透過教學軟硬技巧並用，教導學生發掘那些在不同的文化圈中，以社區為基礎而能夠對於我們的生態、生產、生活環境之永續經營具有跨文化相互理解而足以發人深省的活動。換言之特別的是，本課程以模組方式安排，將實務界與學術界相互協同而發展或研究出來的個案研究、個別故事、哲學討論或對現象的批判，聚焦在以社區為場域的治理活動中呈現，包括團隊合作行動、創意媒體推廣、社區賦權，連結那些在同一個生活世界中相互輻合的個體、團體與組織。因此本課程的基本信念就在於，三重基線(生產、生態、生活)的協同永續必須立基於社會學習、社區賦權與參與，以及對於全球社會經濟的正義所作的承諾。
description.describe_eh: This course explores a compelling range of community-based activities from different cultures and nations which help nurture intercultural understanding and practices of sustainable development. The specially commissioned sessions from practitioners and academics offer a set of interconnected case studies, personal stories, philosophical discussions and critical reflections on direct experiences focusing on co-operative action, creative media innovation and community empowerment connecting individuals, groups, organizations from across our converging world. At the core of the course is a central belief that ecological, social and economic sustainability can only be attained through social learning, community empowerment, participation and a commitment to global and social-economic justice.
